portrait.guidance: The 800×800 portrait repeats the same navy/gold texture behind a warm, nearly frontal subject. Hair begins y≈60 (7.5%); eye line y≈309 (39%); chin y≈522 (65%). Upper body fills much of the lower half and head spans approximately x=250–579 (41%). Large dark glasses are a key recognizable feature, with visible cool reflections in the lenses. A light striped shirt and dark padded vest introduce professional/casual texture; the small garment badge remains visible. Lighting is soft and warm from front-left, but this image is less crisp than the others and the hair/background boundary has some softness. The face is relaxed with closed mouth, direct gaze and a slight angle. The patterned backdrop can compete with fine hair detail; a cleaner area directly behind the head would improve separation.
